LanguageData.WBS_BlueprintDesc: Technical drawings and assembly notes for the {WEAPON} ({TECH}). Studying it teaches the colony to craft this weapon. Pawns study blueprints while reading for recreation, or as Research work.
LanguageData.WBS_BenefitProgress: Colony study progress: {PCT} (about {HOURS} h left for an Intellectual 10 reader)
LanguageData.WBS_BenefitStudyTime: Study time: about {HOURS} h for an Intellectual 10 reader
LanguageData.WBS_LetterStudied: {PAWN} finished studying the {WEAPON} blueprint. The colony can now craft the {WEAPON} at: {BENCHES}.
LanguageData.WBS_LetterReverseEngineered: {PAWN} took apart the {WEAPON} and worked out how it is made. The weapon was used up. The colony can now craft the {WEAPON} at: {BENCHES}.
LanguageData.WBS_LetterNeedsResearch: It will appear in the bill menu once this research is done:
LanguageData.WBS_REAlreadyKnown: The colony already knows the {WEAPON}; it was not taken apart.
LanguageData.WBS_REFailedDamaged: {PAWN} failed to reverse engineer the {WEAPON} (chance {CHANCE}). The weapon was damaged.
LanguageData.WBS_REFailedDestroyed: {PAWN} failed to reverse engineer the {WEAPON} (chance {CHANCE}). The weapon was destroyed.
LanguageData.WBS_OldSaveText:
This save was started without HSK Weapon Blueprints. {COUNT} weapons now need a blueprint or reverse engineering before they can be crafted, including weapons your colony could make before.

Blueprints are not in your existing reading policies. Open the Assign tab's reading policies and allow "weapon blueprints" so colonists read them in their free time. Studying them as Research work works either way.

The mod is meant for new colonies.
LanguageData.WBS_Settings_Threshold: Weapons from this tech level up need a blueprint
LanguageData.WBS_Settings_GateGrenades: Grenades and other throwables need a blueprint
LanguageData.WBS_Settings_GateTools: Survival tools (knives, cleavers, work tools) need a blueprint
LanguageData.WBS_Settings_StudyFirstTip: Order of jobs inside the Research work type. Off: colonists only study blueprints when there is no research bench work.
LanguageData.WBS_Settings_Rewards: Blueprints in quest rewards, item stashes and ancient ruins

LanguageData.WBS_Settings_REDamageMax: Damage on failure, maximum (share of max HP)
